title: A note I only finish for members
excerpt: A quiet note from the morning I leave Newark: the hour before the gate, and the part of the story I keep for members.

featuredImage.alt: Notebook and camera packed for a morning flight

contentHtml:
The public part is the shape of the morning. Coffee, a window seat if the train is kind, and the particular quiet of Newark before the first bank of departures. I have written that morning before. This is the rest of it.

The hour I actually use

I am through security with enough slack to walk, not run. I still want a seat at the gate that faces the window, and I still leave the group chat alone until the door closes. That timing is the thing I stopped putting in the regular posts, because it only helps if you are leaving the same way I do.

What comes with me

A paperback I will not finish, the Lightroom presets I reach for when the terminal light is flat, and one story I do not publish for everyone. If you are a member, this is that story. The excerpt on the way in is the free taste. Hotels and flights on the rest of the site stay open either way.
